name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Common Paper Mutual NDA (Version 1.0) for two parties exchanging confidential information, with a cover page for the key terms.

fields.label: Purpose
fields.help: How Confidential Information may be used.
fields.default: Evaluating whether to enter into a business relationship with the other party.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.help: When the MNDA starts.

fields.label: MNDA Term
fields.help: "expires": the MNDA ends after the MNDA term length; "untilTerminated": it continues until a party terminates it.

fields.label: MNDA term length (years)
fields.help: Used when the MNDA Term is "expires".

fields.label: Term of Confidentiality
fields.help: "years": Confidential Information is protected for the confidentiality length (trade secrets for as long as they remain trade secrets); "perpetual": forever.

fields.label: Confidentiality length (years)
fields.help: Used when the Term of Confidentiality is "years".

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.help: US state whose laws govern the MNDA, e.g. "Delaware".

fields.label: Jurisdiction
fields.help: Courts that hear disputes, e.g. "courts located in New Castle, DE".

fields.label: MNDA Modifications
fields.help: Optional changes to the Standard Terms.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Common Paper Cloud Service Agreement for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products.

fields.label: Cloud Service
fields.help: The cloud service or SaaS product the Provider offers.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.help: When the agreement starts.

fields.label: Order Date
fields.help: Date of the order; often the same as the Effective Date.

fields.label: Subscription Period
fields.help: Length of each subscription term, e.g. "12 months".

fields.label: Fees
fields.help: Subscription fees and payment terms, e.g. "$1,000 per month, invoiced annually, due in 30 days".

fields.label: Non-Renewal Notice Date
fields.help: Deadline for giving notice of non-renewal, e.g. "30 days before the end of the Subscription Period".

fields.label: Technical Support
fields.help: Support the Provider gives, e.g. "email support on business days".

fields.label: DPA
fields.help: Data Processing Agreement that applies, if any.

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.help: Liability cap, e.g. "the fees paid in the 12 months before the claim".

fields.label: Provider Covered Claims
fields.help: Third-party claims the Provider defends the Customer against (indemnity).

fields.label: Customer Covered Claims
fields.help: Third-party claims the Customer defends the Provider against (indemnity).

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.help: US state whose laws govern the agreement, e.g. "Delaware".

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.help: Courts that hear disputes, e.g. "the state or federal courts in New Castle County, Delaware".

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Common Paper Service Level Agreement setting uptime and support response commitments for a cloud service, with service credits.

fields.label: Cloud Service
fields.help: The cloud service the commitments apply to.

fields.label: Subscription Period
fields.help: Subscription term the SLA covers, e.g. "12 months".

fields.label: Target Uptime
fields.help: Monthly availability commitment, e.g. "99.9%".

fields.label: Uptime Credit
fields.help: Service credit when the Target Uptime is missed, e.g. "5% of monthly fees".

fields.label: Target Response Time
fields.help: Time to respond to support requests, e.g. "4 business hours".

fields.label: Response Time Credit
fields.help: Service credit when the Target Response Time is missed.

fields.label: Support Channel
fields.help: How the Customer requests support, e.g. "support@provider.com".

fields.label: Scheduled Downtime
fields.help: Planned maintenance windows excluded from uptime, e.g. "Sundays 2-4am UTC".

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Common Paper Professional Services Agreement for professional services and deliverables described in Statements of Work (SOWs).

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.help: When the agreement starts.

fields.label: Deliverables
fields.help: Services and deliverables in the SOW.

fields.label: SOW Term
fields.help: How long the SOW lasts, e.g. "3 months".

fields.label: Fees
fields.help: Fees for the Services, e.g. "$15,000 fixed fee" or "$150 per hour".

fields.label: Payment Period
fields.help: When invoices are due, e.g. "30 days from invoice".

fields.label: Rejection Period
fields.help: Time the Customer has to reject a Deliverable, e.g. "10 business days".

fields.label: Resubmission Period
fields.help: Time the Provider has to fix and resubmit a rejected Deliverable.

fields.label: Customer Obligations
fields.help: What the Customer must provide, e.g. access, materials, people.

fields.label: Time of Assignment
fields.help: When ownership of Deliverables passes to the Customer, e.g. "upon payment in full".

fields.label: Customer Policies
fields.help: Customer policies the Provider must follow on site.

fields.label: Security Policy
fields.help: Security policy that applies to the Services.

fields.label: DPA
fields.help: Data Processing Agreement that applies, if any.

fields.label: Insurance Minimums
fields.help: Insurance the Provider must carry.

fields.label: Additional Warranties
fields.help: Warranties beyond the Standard Terms.

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.help: Liability cap, e.g. "the fees paid under the SOW".

fields.label: Increased Claims
fields.help: Claims subject to the higher Increased Cap Amount.

fields.label: Increased Cap Amount
fields.help: Higher liability cap for Increased Claims.

fields.label: Unlimited Claims
fields.help: Claims with no liability cap.

fields.label: Provider Covered Claims
fields.help: Third-party claims the Provider defends the Customer against.

fields.label: Customer Covered Claims
fields.help: Third-party claims the Customer defends the Provider against.

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.help: US state whose laws govern the agreement, e.g. "Delaware".

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.help: Courts that hear disputes.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Common Paper Software License Agreement for licensing on-premise or downloadable software.

fields.label: Software
fields.help: The software being licensed.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.help: When the agreement starts.

fields.label: Order Date
fields.help: Date of the order; often the same as the Effective Date.

fields.label: Subscription Period
fields.help: License term, e.g. "12 months".

fields.label: Permitted Uses
fields.help: What the Customer may use the software for.

fields.label: License Limits
fields.help: Limits such as seats, devices or instances.

fields.label: Payment Process
fields.help: Fees and how they are paid, e.g. "$10,000 per year, invoiced annually, due in 30 days".

fields.label: Non-Renewal Notice Date
fields.help: Deadline for giving notice of non-renewal.

fields.label: Warranty Period
fields.help: How long the software warranty lasts, e.g. "90 days".

fields.label: Deletion Procedure
fields.help: How the Customer removes the software when the license ends.

fields.label: Additional Warranties
fields.help: Warranties beyond the Standard Terms.

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.help: Liability cap, e.g. "the fees paid in the 12 months before the claim".

fields.label: Increased Claims
fields.help: Claims subject to the higher Increased Cap Amount.

fields.label: Increased Cap Amount
fields.help: Higher liability cap for Increased Claims.

fields.label: Unlimited Claims
fields.help: Claims with no liability cap.

fields.label: Provider Covered Claims
fields.help: Third-party claims the Provider defends the Customer against.

fields.label: Customer Covered Claims
fields.help: Third-party claims the Customer defends the Provider against.

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.help: US state whose laws govern the agreement, e.g. "Delaware".

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.help: Courts that hear disputes.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Common Paper Data Processing Agreement for processing personal data under GDPR and similar privacy laws, including EU and UK transfer terms.

fields.label: Agreement
fields.help: The main agreement this DPA supplements, e.g. "Cloud Service Agreement dated October 1, 2026".

fields.label: Nature and Purpose of Processing
fields.help: What the Provider does with the personal data and why.

fields.label: Categories of Personal Data
fields.help: E.g. names, email addresses, usage data.

fields.label: Categories of Data Subjects
fields.help: E.g. the Customer's employees and end users.

fields.label: Special Category Data
fields.help: Sensitive data (health, biometrics, ...), if any.

fields.label: Special Category Data Restrictions or Safeguards
fields.help: Extra safeguards for Special Category Data.

fields.label: Frequency of Transfer
fields.help: E.g. "continuous" or "one-off".

fields.label: Duration of Processing
fields.help: E.g. "for the term of the Agreement".

fields.label: Approved Subprocessors
fields.help: Subprocessors the Customer approves, e.g. hosting providers.

fields.label: Provider Security Contact
fields.help: Who to contact about security incidents, e.g. "security@provider.com".

fields.label: Security Policy
fields.help: The Provider's security measures or policy.

fields.label: Governing Member State
fields.help: EU member state whose law governs the transfer clauses, e.g. "Ireland".

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: Common Paper Business Associate Agreement for handling protected health information (PHI) under HIPAA.

fields.label: Agreement
fields.help: The underlying services agreement, e.g. "Cloud Service Agreement dated October 1, 2026".

fields.label: BAA Effective Date
fields.help: When the BAA starts.

fields.label: Breach Notification Period
fields.help: How quickly the Provider reports a breach, e.g. "5 business days".

fields.label: Limitations
fields.help: Restrictions on using or disclosing PHI, e.g. no offshoring or de-identification.

name: AI Addendum
description: Common Paper AI Addendum adding AI-specific terms (training on customer data, inputs and outputs) to a commercial agreement.

fields.label: Agreement
fields.help: The commercial agreement this addendum supplements.

fields.label: Training Data
fields.help: Customer data the Provider may use to train models; if none, training is not allowed.

fields.label: Training Purposes
fields.help: What that training may be used for.

fields.label: Training Restrictions
fields.help: Limits on training.

fields.label: Improvement Restrictions
fields.help: Limits on using inputs and outputs to improve the product.

fields.label: Pilot Period

fields.label: Fees

fields.label: General Cap Amount

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.help: US state whose laws govern the agreement, e.g. "Delaware".

fields.label: Chosen Courts
